title: R’ Kamtzfa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot cites him from Tosafot on Chagigah in the name of the Jerusalem Talmud. Hyman says he has not found him in his Jerusalem Talmud, but in Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah, chapter 1, end of halakhah 2, the name is Rabbi Krispa. See his entry.[^1]

notes.text: Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:2 has the full form Rabbi Krispi in the reviewed paragraph, beside Hyman’s Krispa. His Kamtzfa reading attributed through Seder HaDorot and Tosafot, and his negative observation about his Jerusalem Talmud, remain reports; the cited apparatus chain was not independently established. R’ in the heading leaves Hyman’s abbreviation unexpanded.
